facts.text: The hotel is located across from Disneyland Resort and next to the Anaheim Convention Center.
facts.excerpt: AAA Four Diamond hotel located across from Disneyland Resort and next to the Anaheim Convention Center

facts.text: The hotel sits directly across Katella Avenue from Disney California Adventure Park, within walking distance of the Disneyland Resort.
facts.excerpt: Being directly across Katella Avenue from Disney California Adventure® Park, the hotel is perfectly situated within walking distance to the Disneyland® Resort

facts.text: The hotel is a Disney Good Neighbor Hotel in the highest category, the Superior Hotel Category.
facts.excerpt: As a Disney Good Neighbor Hotel, The Westin Anaheim Resort is designated in the highest category level of the Good Neighbor hotel rating system, the Superior Hotel Category.

facts.text: Signature Theme Park View guestrooms have views of Disney California Adventure Park.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your stay in one of the signature Theme Park View guestrooms, which have spectacular views of Disney California Adventure® Park.

facts.text: Theme Park View rooms, studios and suites let guests watch the Disneyland Resort fireworks.
facts.excerpt: the optimal choice to feel the energy of the theme parks and watch the Disneyland® Resort fireworks

facts.text: Most Theme Park View rooms offer the option of a balcony.
facts.excerpt: Most of the Theme Park View rooms offer the option for a standing balcony, or larger balcony area with

facts.text: The hotel is arranged around a central courtyard, rises gradually up to eight stories, and uses biophilic design to connect guests to nature.
facts.excerpt: arranged around a spacious central courtyard, and massing gradually up to eight stories, the hotel’s contemporary classical architecture with biophilia design connects guests to nature

facts.text: The interior design is inspired by the modern orchard garden, a nod to Anaheim's agricultural origins.
facts.excerpt: the interior design of The Westin Anaheim Resort is inspired by the modern orchard garden and the busy pollinators that bring activity to the orchard

facts.text: Live potted citrus trees line the entrance, the lobby and the rooftop.
facts.excerpt: Live potted citrus trees border the porte cochere and front entrance of the hotel, in the lobby of the hotel, and on the rooftop of the hotel.

facts.text: A living green wall stands behind the check-in counters.
facts.excerpt: The living green wall behind the hotel check-in counters reflect the core principles of biophilia

facts.text: The hotel has a ground-level heated outdoor pool and whirlpool with luxury cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Ground-level, heated outdoor swimming pool and whirlpool with five luxury cabanas

facts.text: The private top-floor Westin Club Lounge has panoramic views of the Disneyland Resort through floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Private top-floor Club Lounge with panoramic views of Disneyland® Resort through floor-to-ceiling windows.

facts.text: RISE Rooftop Lounge is a tapas-style rooftop bar with live music and views of Disney California Adventure Park.
facts.excerpt: our tapas-style Anaheim rooftop bar offers shareable plates, handcrafted cocktails, live music, and views of Disney® California Adventure Park

facts.text: Family activities include Resort Art Quest, where kids search for clues to nature-inspired art pieces in the hotel, and Yoga Fun for Little Ones.
facts.excerpt: Wellness Walks, Resort Art Quest (kids search for clues to nature-inspired art pieces in the hotel), Yoga Fun for Little Ones

facts.text: Concierge associates can help with Disney theme park ticket purchases and park reservations on-site, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: The hotel concierge associates can assist with Disney theme park ticket purchases and park reservations on-site, per availability.

facts.text: The walk to the Disneyland Resort takes about 15 to 20 minutes for most visitors.
facts.excerpt: about 15-20 minutes for most Disney fans

facts.text: The 24-hour Westin WORKOUT Fitness Studio has floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the outdoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Open 24/7, the 2,860 square feet Westin WORKOUT® Fitness Studio is outfitted with floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the resort’s outdoor pool
